newsitem.title: USA: Bank Plus to acquire savings bank.
newsitem.headline: Bank Plus to acquire savings bank.

text.p: Bank Plus Corp said Thursday that its Fidelity Federal Bank FSB subsidiary has a definitive agreement to acquire Hancock Savings Bank FSB for about $12 million.

Hancock Savings Bank currently operates five full-service branches in Los Angeles County. As of March 31, Hancock had assets of about $202 million and retail deposits of about $195 million, compared to Fidelity's assets of $3.3 billion and deposits of $2.5 billion.
The merger is expected to be immediately accretive to Bank Plus's earnings per share, it said.
Under the terms of the agreement, Hancock shareholders are expected to receive Bank Plus common shares Plus in exchange for their Hancock shares at a price range of $9.00 to $9.22 per Hancock share.
The merger is expected to become effective before the end of July 1997, it said.
